label: KTB route frame is the KT route frame plus symmetry (inference)
rule: Conjunction regrouping: frame class KTB is reflexivity together with symmetry
meaning: Certified difference (#1598) of the registration KTB route frame strengthens KT route frame: for every profile, the route frame is KTB iff it is KT and symmetric. The factorization holds by the definition of frame class KTB; premise-free, it asserts no frame condition of the route.
